description: This file defines a generic repository interface 'IRepository<T>' that extends another interface 'IRepositoryBase<T>' and constrains 'T' to be a class implementing 'IAggregateRoot'. It is part of the application core's interfaces for data access abstraction.

classes.name: IRepository<T>
classes.description: A generic repository interface for aggregate root entities, extending 'IRepositoryBase<T>'.
